[P2] Document the required simplification analysis

Rule 2.5, “Simplify before you add,” requires the description to state which simpler options were considered and why they do not work when adding logic. This change adds an operation-detail overload and a scenario-specific factory, but the description only enumerates them and explains the required telemetry output. The rationale for the added setup structure is therefore missing. Please return to the design phase described in rule 8, step 6, and document the simpler alternatives and chosen approach, as rule 9 requires.
